text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy didn't show up for training. 
Worried, I went looking for her, and...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hm! You showed up at just the right time! 
Tadaaa! Take a look at this!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"How's that! Shishimai-chan is squeaky 
clean and shiny! I spent hours grooming 
it!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I warned Shinko Windy not to get so caught 
up in the fun that she forgot to train.
